<b>Shredded Organs</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
15 [[Seared Organ]]s, 35 Shredded Organs, and 10 [[Skewered Organ]]s are required to complete the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> [[Wish]], given by [[Huntress]] at [[Putrified Ducts]] (or the <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> Wish, given by [[Runt]] in the same location after [[Act 3]] begins).

== How to Acquire ==
Only obtainable while <i>Broodfeast</i> or <i>Runtfeast</i> is active. 3 Shredded Organs drop from most enemies killed by the following sources:
* [[Sawtooth Circlet]]
* [[Cogwork Wheel]]
* [[Delver's Drill]]
* [[Conchcutter]]
* [[Beast Crest]]'s downwards attack
* [[Architect Crest]]'s charged down-slash/[[Swift Step|run-slash]] and [[Needle Strike]]

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 35 Shredded Organs, after which they are no longer obtainable.
